people-yearbyyear.json.note: gen-org's person request (scripts/data/gen-org.mjs). Two players, one per stat group.

person-season.json.note: The prospect card's request (src/lib/model/card.js), pinned to 2026 so a finished season's content cannot change.

person-season-multilevel.json.note: The prospect card's request for 2025: one split per level plus a Minors total.

roster-season-2025-biloxi.json.note: gen-archive's roster request (scripts/data/gen-archive.mjs). Trimmed to six players.

people-mlb-yearbyyear.json.note: gen-mlb's person request (scripts/data/gen-mlb.mjs). Cameron and Gallardo, trimmed to a few seasons; Cameron's 2011 has a traded-player total split with no team and numTeams 2. Made has no MLB rows and no stats block.

people-milb-careers.json.note: gen-careers' person request (scripts/data/gen-careers.mjs). Sheets and Gagne, bio fields trimmed. Sheets has no-team totals (sportId 21) and clubs outside the Brewers system; Gagne has no totals.

standings-2019-pioneer.json.note: The standings request (scripts/data/lib/standings.mjs) for the Pioneer League, 2019. Two teams kept, and each team's nested records block dropped. Includes Rocky Mountain Vibes (551), 32-43, division rank 3. Strings: winningPercentage, divisionRank.

standings-2006-arizona.json.note: The same request for the Arizona League, 2006. AZL Brewers (406) only. This league had no divisions: the team record has no divisionRank, and the record has no division.
